# codebase-execudeck

Deck-style executive surface. Visual reference only.

## Stack & contents

Next.js / TypeScript. ~81 files under `code/execudeck/{app,docs,config,.superpowers}`. Extensive docs: `AGENT_MODEL.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `CLI_SYSTEM.md`, `MANIFEST_SYSTEM.md`, `ROADMAP.md`. Includes `.superpowers/brainstorm/` HTML design artifacts.

## Why this is here

Useful as a fully-elaborated alternative architecture to compare against EMA — same problem domain, different decisions. Read `docs/AGENT_MODEL.md` and `docs/MANIFEST_SYSTEM.md` when designing identity/permissions.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-execudeck:code/execudeck/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
git show origin/codebase-execudeck:code/execudeck/docs/plans/2026-02-18-phase1-scaffold-plan.md
```

## Doctrine extracted (2026-04-22)

Carries forward (principles, not code):
- **Trust Zones** — only the human signature promotes a draft to persistent state; rendering and orchestration are explicitly stripped of mutation rights (`code/execudeck/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §4 "Trust & Safety Zones": Zone 0/1/2).
- **Scoped on-demand context** — agents pull context through an ID-addressed query channel governed by an explicit access policy, never carrying ambient state (`docs/AGENT_MODEL.md` §1 "Context Access Mechanism").
- **Schema-driven artifacts** — a tree + inspector + JSON-transform model is the source of truth, so every mutation is replayable (`docs/MANIFEST_SYSTEM.md` §1 "Editing Model").

Leaves behind (residue):
- React/Tambo terminal grammar and the 50/50 vertical split UX (`docs/CLI_SYSTEM.md`).
- The named MVP component catalog (Card/DataTable/LineChart/NavGroup/TextElement) (`docs/MANIFEST_SYSTEM.md` §3).

Topic relevance: `authority`, `surface`, `doctrine`, `ux-metaphor`, `identity`, `orchestration`.
